FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

This FAQ will answer some of the more general questions you might have about your order, click a question below to fast-forward to a section.

expand_more What happens after I place my order?

Once your order is received our provisioning team will verify your order details, then perform some additional checks on your order.

expand_more When can I use the order tracker?

As soon as your order is placed you'll have access to My Account, from here you can track your order, and much much more.

expand_more How long does it take to complete my order?

The table below provides an estimate on how long most orders take, note that delivery times may vary (in some cases considerably) due to infrastructure issues.

Order Type Average ETA More Information
Mobile 3-4 Business Days Mobile Setup Process
Residential Telephone 1-5 Business Days Telephone Setup Process
Business Telephone 1-5 Business Days Business Phone Setup Process
Business VoIP 1-2 Business Days VoIP Setup Process
Broadband Bundles 6-14 Business Days Broadband Bundle Setup Process
Business Bundles 6-14 Business Days Business Bundles Setup Process
NBN Bundles 9-24 Business Days (much faster with existing NTD) NBN Setup Process

expand_more How does SpinTel keep me updated on my order progress?

At almost every step of the way we will keep you updated on your order, you should expect to receive emails & SMS from us when you order is submitted, and when it is completed.

expand_more What if there are issues with my order?

Occasionally we may run into issues, this can happen at any stage of the install process. If this happens we will notify you via email, and one of our agents will call you ASAP to attempt to resolve whatever issue may have ocured.

expand_more When will I get my first bill?

You'll receive your first bill when your service is activated. It will contain any set up and other one-off charges such as modem charges, as well as a pro-rata charge till the end of the billing period.


Your second bill will contain a full month's charge for your services and will generally be received about the same time each month. You can read more about our billing.
For an easy way to view and manage your bills, download the SpinTel app from the App Store or Google Play.

TERMS

All of our products are covered by SpinTel's Standard Form of Agreement and are subject to our Acceptable Use Policy (AUP).

NBN Key Fact Sheet

Things To Know

This page summarises some helpful things to know; if you have any questions, please call us on 13 22 10.

  • Prices displayed on this page include GST.
  • Payment options include direct debit from a nominated savings, cheque or credit card account.
  • A New Development Charge of $300 inc. GST applies to all NBN services if deemed by the NBN Co as a new development. We'll contact you if your premises is deemed a new development, and you can choose to pay and proceed with your order.
  • Service is billed monthly in advance.
  • Service is not available in all areas.
  • The plan is subject to our Acceptable Use Policy (AUP).
  • If requested, your service will be cancelled at the end of your current billing cycle.
  • In most cases, you can retain your current landline telephone number.
  • Connection times vary depending on the pre-provisioning steps nbn has already carried out for your premises. Once the order has been submitted, we will inform you of the installation date.
  • 39¢ call connection charge applies to timed calls and is in addition to International Special or max cost call rates.
  • Timed calls are billed in 60-second increments.
  • The Top 50 International Special is available 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
  • Home phone features available may differ from your current provider. A list of home phone features is displayed here.
  • The SpinTel NBN phone service does not support calls to 19/1900, 0500 and Universal International Freephone Numbers (UIFN).
  • If applicable, an early termination fee of $99 pro-rata applies to the home phone service should you cancel within your contract term.
  • If applicable, an early termination fee of $99 pro-rata applies to the broadband service should you cancel within your contract term.
  • Promotional contract credit may be withdrawn if the service is terminated early.
  • Promotional offers are only available to new customers connecting to an eligible service for the first time and not available to customers with an existing SpinTel NBN service. It is only available once per customer per premises.
  • You may lose, or we may modify the promotional discounts if you change your plan during the promotional period.
  • You may change plans at any time during your contract.
  • There is no charge to upgrade or downgrade your plan.
  • Data usage is counted in gigabytes, where 1 gigabyte (GB) = 1000 megabytes (MB).
  • Unused download data is forfeited at the end of each billing month.

TP-Link VR400 WiFi GIGABIT Gateway




Speedy WiFi – Experience superb wireless connections with 867 Mbps (5 GHz) + 300 Mbps (2.4 GHz) dual band WiFi

Superior Range – Two fixed omnidirectional antennas with Beamforming technology provide stable wireless connections and optimal coverage

Versatile Connectivity – Fully compatible with VDSL2/ADSL2+/ADSL2/ADSL standards, as well as fiber, cable, and 3G/4G internet services

Whole-Home Coverage with OneMeshTM – Works alongside TP-Link OneMeshTM products to create a flexible Mesh network

MU-MIMO Technology – Simultaneously transfers data to multiple devices, reducing wait times

Tether App– TP-Link Tether provides the easiest way to access and manage your router on your iOS and Android devices

TP-Link VR2100v WiFi VoIP GIGABIT Gateway


Super VDSL – The Latest Super VDSL (VDSL2 Profile 35b) tech delivers internet speeds of up to 350 Mbps

Ultra-Fast Speed –Surpasses the WiFi speed limits of the previous generation, reaching up to 1733 Mbps on 5 GHz and 300 Mbps on 2.4 GHz

HD Telephony – Supports up to 6 cordless phones via DECT along with two analog telephones or fax machines, as well as 300 minutes of voice mail storage

MU-MIMO Technology – Simultaneously transfers data to multiple devices to reduce congestion and boost the average throughput

Whole-Home Coverage with OneMeshTM – Works with TP-Link OneMesh products to create a flexible and cost-efficient Mesh network

Lightning-Fast Wired Connection – USB 3.0 port and 4× Gigabit ports run up to 10x faster than the previous generation to unleash your home entertainment

TP-Link Tether App – Easily access and manage your network via the Tether app, such as remote control and automatic updates

Google Nest Wi-Fi










Nest Wifi blankets your whole home in strong reliable coverage.
It works behind the scenes to keep your Wi-Fi fast and buffering at bay. Nest Wifi is easy to set up then connect and manage devices on your network. Plus, pause Wi-Fi to limit screen time for the kids.
Automatic updates help your network stay safe and sound. And when you need some extra help, just ask your Google Assistant in your Nest Wifi point.
Use your voice to control connected devices, play your favourite music, broadcast messages around the house and more.

MODEMS


TP-Link VR400 WiFi GIGABIT Gateway



Speedy WiFi – Experience superb wireless connections with 867 Mbps (5 GHz) + 300 Mbps (2.4 GHz) dual band WiFi

Superior Range – Two fixed omnidirectional antennas with Beamforming technology provide stable wireless connections and optimal coverage

Versatile Connectivity – Fully compatible with VDSL2/ADSL2+/ADSL2/ADSL standards, as well as fiber, cable, and 3G/4G internet services

Whole-Home Coverage with OneMeshTM – Works alongside TP-Link OneMeshTM products to create a flexible Mesh network

MU-MIMO Technology – Simultaneously transfers data to multiple devices, reducing wait times

Tether App– TP-Link Tether provides the easiest way to access and manage your router on your iOS and Android devices

TP-Link VR2100v WiFi VoIP GIGABIT Gateway


Super VDSL – The Latest Super VDSL (VDSL2 Profile 35b) tech delivers internet speeds of up to 350 Mbps

Ultra-Fast Speed –Surpasses the WiFi speed limits of the previous generation, reaching up to 1733 Mbps on 5 GHz and 300 Mbps on 2.4 GHz

HD Telephony – Supports up to 6 cordless phones via DECT along with two analog telephones or fax machines, as well as 300 minutes of voice mail storage

MU-MIMO Technology – Simultaneously transfers data to multiple devices to reduce congestion and boost the average throughput

Whole-Home Coverage with OneMeshTM – Works with TP-Link OneMesh products to create a flexible and cost-efficient Mesh network

Lightning-Fast Wired Connection – USB 3.0 port and 4× Gigabit ports run up to 10x faster than the previous generation to unleash your home entertainment

TP-Link Tether App – Easily access and manage your network via the Tether app, such as remote control and automatic updates

Google Nest Wi-Fi










Nest Wifi blankets your whole home in strong reliable coverage. It works behind the scenes to keep your Wi-Fi fast and buffering at bay.

Nest Wifi is easy to set up then connect and manage devices on your network. Plus, pause Wi-Fi to limit screen time for the kids.

Automatic updates help your network stay safe and sound. And when you need some extra help, just ask your Google Assistant in your Nest Wifi point.

Use your voice to control connected devices, play your favourite music, broadcast messages around the house and more.

Nest Wifi manages your whole connected home. One router with one point is strong enough to handle up to 200 connected devices, and fast enough to stream multiple 4K videos at a time.
